name: Milk Girl Buys Some Milk
storyline: The game begins in Grey County with milk girl waking up and wishing to drink milk but having none. She journeys across grey path to reach the store, avoiding enemies and spikes and reading guidance from a friendly sign writer. At the store she finds that her wallet was left at home. A journey back through scaffolding and rails lit by sunset and guided by an UNfriendly sign writer has her return home only to find she had the wallet all along and didn't look hard enough. We then cut to the store where customers and cashiers must be avoided and conveyor belts navigated. Upon finding the freezers, no milk is to be found, instead Milk Girl is pulled into an outer space-like freezer world where she must explore to find the milk.
